summary.note: r_modulus_cv, p_modulus_cv, r_modulus_mean_glucose, and p_modulus_mean_glucose are from the original analysis pipeline operating on raw 5-minute CGM time-series (Zhao et al. 2023). They cannot be independently re-derived from the per-subject summary rows in this JSON because the CV% and mean glucose used in the original analysis were computed across all raw readings (multi-day clinical values), whereas the per-subject fields here are derived from stored summary statistics. These values are stored as authoritative archived results and locked by the regression test.

r_modulus_mean_glucose.pipeline: Pearson r between per-subject AR(2) eigenvalue modulus |λ| and multi-day clinical mean glucose. Mean glucose was computed as the arithmetic mean of all raw 5-minute CGM readings across all recording days for each subject (not the per-window mean stored in the results rows). AR(2) fit used mean-centred OLS on 24-hour windows (288 samples/day); see fit_ar2_demeaned() in manuscripts/scripts/cgm_shanghai_ar2_analysis.py. p-value is two-tailed via regularised incomplete beta; see pearson() in manuscripts/scripts/colas2019_cgm_ar2_analysis.py.
r_modulus_mean_glucose.raw_data_source: Zhao Z et al. ShanghaiT2DM: A Shanghai-based continuous glucose monitoring dataset for type 2 diabetes mellitus. Scientific Data 10, 175 (2023). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-023-02084-6
r_modulus_mean_glucose.why_not_reproducible_from_rows: The per-subject meanGlucose fields in the results array are per-window means averaged over days; the original pipeline used the mean of every raw 5-minute reading, which differs due to within-subject variation in recording-day length and non-uniform window coverage. Computing Pearson r from the stored rows gives approximately -0.447 (negative direction preserved; magnitude diverges due to the aggregation difference).

r_modulus_cv.pipeline: Pearson r between per-subject AR(2) eigenvalue modulus |λ| and multi-day clinical CV%. CV% computed as (SD / mean) × 100 across all raw 5-minute readings for each subject. Same AR(2) fitting and p-value method as r_modulus_mean_glucose above.
r_modulus_cv.raw_data_source: Zhao Z et al. ShanghaiT2DM. Scientific Data 10, 175 (2023). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-023-02084-6
r_modulus_cv.why_not_reproducible_from_rows: Per-subject cvGlucose in the results array is the CV of per-window means, not the CV of all raw 5-minute readings. The multi-day clinical CV% captured in the original analysis differs numerically.
